draft.subject: Dearborn Heating & Cooling: your Free Quote on New and Replacement Systems link
draft.body:
Hi Dearborn Heating & Cooling team,

I’m Zach with Fouse Digital. While reviewing your heating and cooling website at https://dearbornheatingcooling.com/, I found a specific contact-path issue: The “Free Quote on New and Replacement Systems” contact control’s label was clipped at both 375px and 390px; its center was outside the visible, non-pannable area.

I can help adjust the contact control’s responsive layout and recheck it at both phone widths. Would you like me to send a short lead-path review showing the link and suggested fix?

Zach
Fouse Digital
https://zfouse.github.io/fouse-digital/
